name: rhoprime2
title: The second derivative of the rho function
description: The second derivative of the rho function

arguments.description: point or vector at which rho is to be evaluated

family string specifying the name of the family of loss function to be used (current valid
options are "bisquare", "opt" and "mopt").

tuning parameters to be computed according to efficiency and / or breakdown
considerations. See `lmrobdet.control`, `bisquare`, `mopt`
and `opt`.

logical value determining whether the rho function is to be
standardized so that its maximum value is 1. See `Mpsi`.

examples_r:
# Evaluate the 2nd derivative of a rho function tuned for 85\% efficiency
rhoprime2(u=1.1, family='bisquare', cc=bisquare(.85))
# Evaluate the 2nd derivative of a rho function tuned for 50\% breakdown
rhoprime2(u=1.1, family='opt', cc=lmrobdet.control(bb=.5, family='opt')$tuning.chi)
author: Matias Salibian-Barrera, <matias@stat.ubc.ca>
